expectations.historical: V2/V3 bot digests and continuation unchanged
expectations.neutral: Equivalent colors and reordered archetypes have equal opening value
expectations.marginal: A missing early play is more useful than an excluded duplicate filler
expectations.mana: Inaccessible green producers cannot support red in a WU configuration
expectations.cycling: Typed nonbasics are searchable; missing targets give zero fixing; candidate added basics can enable a splash
expectations.slots: Alternative uses occupy one slot and never full creature plus full land credit
expectations.synergy: Reference support centers the adjustment, absent support lowers it, density and competition matter
expectations.coverage: Partial relational data disable both bonuses and penalties uniformly
expectations.signals: Side memory survives reversal; subpicks do not duplicate evidence; late depth matters
expectations.pivot: Discarded unplayables do not add sunk cost; better constructible plans can replace the current plan
expectations.profiles: Attackers and defense differ for aggro/control; signals differs usefully from neutral or is unified
expectations.random: One seat consuming random values does not shift any other seat decision stream
expectations.picktwo: A legal chosen pair is evaluated jointly without hidden information
expectations.privacy: Opponent pools and logs are exported by the UI only at completion
expectations.match: Same game-one assumptions give the same main; BO1 has no between-game sideboard value

promotion: Experimental until the reserved sample and blind review support promotion; internal objective is not independent proof or WR
